## Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center"
)

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(grid)
library(survival)
library(survminer)

FONT_FAMILY       <- "sans"  # avoids Windows Arial database warnings
FONT_SCALE        <- 1.00    # e.g. 1.10 makes every font 10% larger
FIG_WIDTH         <- 8
FIG_HEIGHT        <- 8
OUTPUT_DPI        <- 600

FORCE_RERUN_MODELS   <- FALSE
FORCE_REFRESH_CLINICAL <- FALSE

OUTPUT_ROOT <- "survival_output"   # deposited copy: was a local absolute path
SOURCE_DATA <- "../source_data/Main_Figure/fig5"
CACHE_DIR   <- file.path(OUTPUT_ROOT, "cache")
FIGURE_DIR  <- file.path(OUTPUT_ROOT, "figures")
DATA_DIR    <- file.path(OUTPUT_ROOT, "data")

dir.create(CACHE_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(FIGURE_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(DATA_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

fs <- function(size) size * FONT_SCALE

load_or_compute <- function(cache_name, compute_fun, force = FALSE) {
  cache_path <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, paste0(cache_name, ".rds"))

  if (!force && file.exists(cache_path)) {
    message("Loaded cache: ", cache_path)
    return(readRDS(cache_path))
  }

  message("Computing: ", cache_name)
  result <- compute_fun()
  saveRDS(result, cache_path)
  message("Saved cache: ", cache_path)
  result
}

save_plot_pair <- function(plot_object, file_stem,
                           width = FIG_WIDTH, height = FIG_HEIGHT) {
  plot_to_save <- if (inherits(plot_object, "ggsurvplot")) {
    plot_object$plot
  } else {
    plot_object
  }

  pdf_path <- file.path(FIGURE_DIR, paste0(file_stem, ".pdf"))
  png_path <- file.path(FIGURE_DIR, paste0(file_stem, ".png"))

  tryCatch(
    ggsave(
      pdf_path, plot = plot_to_save, device = cairo_pdf,
      width = width, height = height, units = "in", bg = "white"
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      ggsave(
        pdf_path, plot = plot_to_save, device = "pdf",
        width = width, height = height, units = "in", bg = "white"
      )
    }
  )

  ggsave(
    png_path, plot = plot_to_save,
    width = width, height = height, units = "in",
    dpi = OUTPUT_DPI, bg = "white"
  )

  message("Saved: ", pdf_path)
  message("Saved: ", png_path)
}

risk_group_labels <- function(data) {
  c(
    sprintf("High Risk Group (n=%d)", sum(data$group == "high")),
    sprintf("Low Risk Group (n=%d)", sum(data$group == "low"))
  )
}

draw_two_group_km <- function(
    fit,
    data,
    legend_labels,
    palette,
    pval_size,
    overall_size,
    axis_title_size,
    axis_text_size,
    legend_text_size,
    legend_key_width_cm = 1,
    legend_spacing_cm = 0.5,
    pval_coord = c(10, 0.10),
    curve_size = 2,
    censor_size = 6) {

  p <- ggsurvplot(
    fit,
    data = data,
    pval = TRUE,
    pval.size = fs(pval_size),
    pval.coord = pval_coord,
    conf.int = TRUE,
    linetype = "strata",
    surv.median.line = "hv",
    size = curve_size,
    censor.size = censor_size,
    ggtheme = theme_classic(base_family = FONT_FAMILY),
    palette = palette,
    legend.labs = legend_labels,
    xlab = "Time (Months)",
    ylab = "Survival Probability"
  )

  p$plot <- p$plot + theme(
    text = element_text(size = fs(overall_size), family = FONT_FAMILY),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = fs(legend_text_size), face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = fs(axis_title_size)),
    axis.text = element_text(size = fs(axis_text_size), color = "black"),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 1),
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 1),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = "transparent"),
    legend.key.width = unit(legend_key_width_cm, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.x = unit(legend_spacing_cm, "cm"),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 30, 20, 10)
  )

  p
}

print_cox_metrics <- function(cox_model) {
  cox_sum <- summary(cox_model)
  hr_value <- round(cox_sum$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"], 2)
  hr_lower <- round(cox_sum$conf.int[1, "lower .95"], 2)
  hr_upper <- round(cox_sum$conf.int[1, "upper .95"], 2)
  p_value <- signif(cox_sum$sctest["pvalue"], 3)
  c_index <- round(cox_sum$concordance["C"], 3)

  cat("\n========= Model metrics =========\n")
  cat("C-index      :", c_index, "\n")
  cat("Hazard ratio :", hr_value,
      "(95% CI:", hr_lower, "-", hr_upper, ")\n")
  cat("Cox P-value  :", p_value, "\n")
  cat("=================================\n")
}
```

## Functions

```{r shared-functions}
get_kirc_clinical <- function() {
  load_or_compute(
    "tcga_kirc_clinical",
    force = FORCE_REFRESH_CLINICAL,
    compute_fun = function() {
      if (!requireNamespace("TCGAbiolinks", quietly = TRUE)) {
        stop("TCGAbiolinks is required only when the clinical cache is absent.")
      }

      query <- TCGAbiolinks::GDCquery(
        project = "TCGA-KIRC",
        data.category = "Clinical",
        data.type = "Clinical Supplement",
        data.format = "BCR Biotab"
      )

      TCGAbiolinks::GDCdownload(query)
      clinical_raw <- TCGAbiolinks::GDCprepare(query)
      clinical <- clinical_raw$clinical_patient_kirc

      clinical %>%
        transmute(
          patient_id = bcr_patient_barcode,
          days_to_death = death_days_to,
          days_to_last_followup = last_contact_days_to,
          vital_status = vital_status,
          os_days = ifelse(
            vital_status == "Dead",
            as.numeric(days_to_death),
            as.numeric(days_to_last_followup)
          ),
          os_months = os_days / 30.44,
          os_event = ifelse(vital_status == "Dead", 1, 0)
        ) %>%
        filter(!is.na(os_months), os_months > 0)
    }
  )
}

prepare_kirc_features <- function(feature_path, survival_data) {
  feature_df <- read.csv(feature_path)
  feature_df$patient_id <- substr(feature_df$patient_id, 1, 12)
  feature_df <- feature_df[feature_df$patient_id != "average", ]

  feature_df$count_divided_by_tissue <-
    feature_df$cell_count / feature_df$Tissue.area..mm2.
  feature_df$area_px <- NULL
  feature_df$mpp <- NULL
  feature_df$cell_count <- NULL
  feature_df$Tissue.area..mm2. <- NULL
  feature_df$file_orig <- NULL
  feature_df$file_annotated <- NULL
  feature_df$count_divided_by_tissue <- NULL

  feature_df <- feature_df[, vapply(
    feature_df,
    function(column) length(unique(column)) > 1,
    logical(1)
  )]
  feature_df <- feature_df[, !grepl("_mean$|_std$", colnames(feature_df))]

  feature_df %>%
    left_join(
      survival_data %>% select(patient_id, os_months, os_event),
      by = "patient_id"
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(os_months), !is.na(os_event), os_months > 0)
}

run_strict_loocv <- function(data, exclude_cols,
                             eta, max_depth, subsample,
                             nrounds = 100, seed = 1) {
  if (!requireNamespace("xgboost", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("xgboost is required only when the model cache is absent.")
  }

  final_df <- data
  final_df$patient_id <- NULL
  label <- ifelse(
    final_df$os_event == 1,
    final_df$os_months,
    -final_df$os_months
  )

  risk_scores <- numeric(nrow(final_df))
  patient_groups <- character(nrow(final_df))
  feature_importances <- vector("list", nrow(final_df))

  set.seed(seed)

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(final_df))) {
    is_train <- seq_len(nrow(final_df)) != i
    predictor_columns <- !colnames(final_df) %in% exclude_cols

    x_train <- as.matrix(final_df[is_train, predictor_columns])
    x_test <- as.matrix(final_df[i, predictor_columns, drop = FALSE])

    dtrain <- xgboost::xgb.DMatrix(x_train, label = label[is_train])
    dtest <- xgboost::xgb.DMatrix(x_test)

    model <- xgboost::xgb.train(
      params = list(
        objective = "survival:cox",
        eval_metric = "cox-nloglik",
        eta = eta,
        max_depth = max_depth,
        subsample = subsample
      ),
      data = dtrain,
      nrounds = nrounds,
      verbose = 0
    )

    train_risk <- predict(model, dtrain)
    inner_cutoff <- median(train_risk)
    test_risk <- predict(model, dtest)

    risk_scores[i] <- test_risk
    patient_groups[i] <- ifelse(test_risk >= inner_cutoff, "high", "low")
    feature_importances[[i]] <- xgboost::xgb.importance(model = model)
  }

  importance_avg <- bind_rows(feature_importances, .id = "fold") %>%
    group_by(Feature) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_Gain = mean(Gain, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_Cover = mean(Cover, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_Frequency = mean(Frequency, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_folds_used = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_Gain))

  list(
    risk_scores = risk_scores,
    patient_groups = patient_groups,
    importance_avg = importance_avg
  )
}

assemble_model_bundle <- function(data, model_result) {
  data$risk_scores <- model_result$risk_scores
  data$group <- factor(
    model_result$patient_groups,
    levels = c("high", "low")
  )

  fit <- survfit(Surv(os_months, os_event) ~ group, data = data)
  cox_check <- coxph(Surv(os_months, os_event) ~ group, data = data)

  list(
    data = data,
    fit = fit,
    cox_check = cox_check,
    medians = surv_median(fit),
    importance_avg = model_result$importance_avg
  )
}
```

```{r kirc-g3-analysis}
kirc_g3 <- load_or_compute(
  "kirc_g3_xgb_loocv",
  force = FORCE_RERUN_MODELS,
  compute_fun = function() {
    inter_df <- read.csv(file.path(SOURCE_DATA, "5f_KIRC_G3_survival_with_LOOCV_predictions.csv"))
    inter_df$risk_scores <- NULL
    inter_df$group <- NULL

    model_result <- run_strict_loocv(
      inter_df,
      exclude_cols = c("os_months", "os_event"),
      eta = 0.1,
      max_depth = 6,
      subsample = 0.9,
      nrounds = 100,
      seed = 1
    )

    assemble_model_bundle(inter_df, model_result)
  }
)

  file.path(DATA_DIR, "KIRC_G3_survival_with_LOOCV_predictions.csv"),

)
```

```{r lgg-analysis}
lgg_grade <- load_or_compute(
  "lgg_grade2_vs_grade3",
  compute_fun = function() {
    data <- read.csv(
      file.path(SOURCE_DATA, "5a_TCGA_G2G3_LGG_Survival.csv")
    ) %>%
      filter(
        GRADE %in% c("G2", "G3"),
        SUBTYPE == "IDHmut-codel",
        OS_MONTHS > 0
      )

    data$subtype.grade <- factor(
      paste(data$GRADE, data$SUBTYPE),
      levels = c("G2 IDHmut-codel", "G3 IDHmut-codel")
    )

    fit <- survfit(
      Surv(OS_MONTHS, os.status) ~ subtype.grade,
      data = data
    )

    list(data = data, fit = fit, medians = surv_median(fit))
  }
)
```

```{r oligos-g3-analysis}
oligos_g3 <- load_or_compute(
  "oligos_g3_xgb_loocv",
  force = FORCE_RERUN_MODELS,
  compute_fun = function() {
    feature_df <- read.csv(
      file.path(SOURCE_DATA, "5b_Oligos_G3_survival_with_LOOCV_predictions.csv")
    ) %>%
      select(-risk_scores, -group) %>%
      filter(!is.na(os_months), !is.na(os_event), os_months > 0)

    feature_df$patient_id <- substr(feature_df$patient_id, 1, 12)
    feature_df <- feature_df[feature_df$patient_id != "average", ]
    feature_df$file_orig <- NULL
    feature_df$file_annotated <- NULL

    feature_df <- feature_df[, vapply(
      feature_df,
      function(column) length(unique(column)) > 1,
      logical(1)
    )]
    feature_df <- feature_df[, !grepl("_mean$|_std$", colnames(feature_df))]

    model_result <- run_strict_loocv(
      feature_df,
      exclude_cols = c(
        "os_months", "os_event",
        "HISTOPATHOLOGY_GRADE", "time_yrs"
      ),
      eta = 0.05,
      max_depth = 5,
      subsample = 0.9,
      nrounds = 100,
      seed = 1
    )

    bundle <- assemble_model_bundle(feature_df, model_result)
    bundle$c_index <- concordance(
      Surv(os_months, os_event) ~ risk_scores,
      data = bundle$data
    )
    bundle$continuous_cox <- coxph(
      Surv(os_months, os_event) ~ risk_scores,
      data = bundle$data
    )
    bundle
  }
)
```

## Supplementary Fig 17

```{r oligos-top-feature-analysis}
oligos_top_feature <- load_or_compute(
  "oligos_g3_top_single_feature",
  compute_fun = function() {
    target_feature <- "Nucleus.Intensity.Mean_median"

    data <- read.csv(
      file.path(SOURCE_DATA, "5b_Oligos_G3_survival_with_LOOCV_predictions.csv")
    ) %>%
      select(-risk_scores, -group) %>%
      filter(!is.na(os_months), !is.na(os_event), os_months > 0)

    data$patient_id <- substr(data$patient_id, 1, 12)

    if (!target_feature %in% colnames(data)) {
      stop("Target feature is absent: ", target_feature)
    }

    data <- data[, c("patient_id", "os_months", "os_event", target_feature)]
    formula <- as.formula(
      paste("Surv(os_months, os_event) ~", target_feature)
    )
    cox_univ <- coxph(formula, data = data)
    coefficient <- coef(cox_univ)[1]
    cutoff <- median(data[[target_feature]], na.rm = TRUE)

    if (coefficient > 0) {
      data$group <- ifelse(data[[target_feature]] >= cutoff, "high", "low")
    } else {
      data$group <- ifelse(data[[target_feature]] < cutoff, "high", "low")
    }
    data$group <- factor(data$group, levels = c("high", "low"))

    fit <- survfit(Surv(os_months, os_event) ~ group, data = data)
    group_cox <- coxph(Surv(os_months, os_event) ~ group, data = data)

    list(
      data = data,
      fit = fit,
      cox_univ = cox_univ,
      group_cox = group_cox,
      cutoff = cutoff,
      medians = surv_median(fit),
      target_feature = target_feature
    )
  }
)

write.csv(
  oligos_top_feature$data,
  file.path(DATA_DIR, "Oligos_G3_top_feature_survival_data.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("Feature:", oligos_top_feature$target_feature, "\n")
cat("Median cutoff:", oligos_top_feature$cutoff, "\n")
print(table(oligos_top_feature$data$group))
print(oligos_top_feature$medians)
print(summary(oligos_top_feature$cox_univ))
print_cox_metrics(oligos_top_feature$group_cox)
```

## Fig 5e

```{r kirc-grades-analysis}
kirc_grades <- load_or_compute(
  "kirc_grade2_grade3_grade4",
  compute_fun = function() {
    data <- read.csv(
      file.path(SOURCE_DATA, "5e_TCGA_G2G3G4_KIRC_survival.csv"),  # deposited copy (was 6e_..., same table)
      check.names = FALSE
    )

    data <- data[
      !is.na(data$os_months) &
        !is.na(data$os_event) &
        !is.na(data$grade) &
        data$os_months > 0,
    ]
    data$grade <- factor(
      data$grade,
      levels = c("Grade 2", "Grade 3", "Grade 4")
    )
    data <- droplevels(data)

    fit <- survfit(Surv(os_months, os_event) ~ grade, data = data)
    logrank <- survdiff(Surv(os_months, os_event) ~ grade, data = data)
    df_logrank <- length(logrank$n) - 1
    exact_p <- pchisq(logrank$chisq, df = df_logrank, lower.tail = FALSE)

    list(
      data = data,
      fit = fit,
      medians = surv_median(fit),
      logrank = logrank,
      df_logrank = df_logrank,
      exact_p = exact_p
    )
  }
)

write.csv(
  kirc_grades$data,
  file.path(DATA_DIR, "KIRC_Grade2_Grade3_Grade4_survival_data.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

print(table(kirc_grades$data$grade))
print(kirc_grades$medians)
cat(sprintf(
  "Overall log-rank: chi-square(%d) = %.8f; exact P = %.12g\n",
  kirc_grades$df_logrank,
  unname(kirc_grades$logrank$chisq),
  kirc_grades$exact_p
))
```
